title: New white paper: Latam's E-commerce Evolution 2025-2028
summary: Dive into the current and future perspectives for key industries in the region's main markets: Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru.
body_markdown:
January 19, 2026


Our new white paper is out! On[Latam’s E-commerce Evolution: 2025 Opportunities Report](https://insights.international.pagseguro.com/latam-ecommerce-evolution-white-paper) , we dive into the current and future perspectives for key industries in the region's main markets: Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru.


Produced in partnership with Payments and Commerce Market Intelligence (PCMI), the study details the opportunities and growth drivers for cross-border merchants


, from market volumes to payment method usage


. Our goal with the material is to provide exclusive data and actionable insights to continue fomenting e-commerce and payment-driven volume in Latam.


To download the full study for free, just click below:


[Dive into Latin America's 2025-2028 e-commerce scenario](https://insights.international.pagseguro.com/latam-ecommerce-evolution-white-paper)
